---
title: "Baseball by the Numbers"
---

This site uses Lahman baseball records to explore how home-run hitting has changed over time. Home runs per team game rose from about 0.79 in 1990 to a peak of 1.39 in 2019, before falling to about 1.12 in 2024.

The Sluggers page ranks career home-run leaders: Barry Bonds leads with 762, followed by Hank Aaron and Babe Ruth. Use the analysis pages in the navbar to explore the season-by-season trend and the player leaderboard.
